staleSupersededAsCurrentTrustedTruth.note: The carve-out special check confirmed Headroom did not treat the deleted 5.02(g)/6.01(d) carve-out as current trusted truth; it flagged the dangling cross-reference. The operative-state failure produced no operative document at all (empty), so there is no stale document being asserted as current.

crossTenantContamination.note: riot-phase-3f2-unseen tenant ID used throughout; no cross-tenant reads/writes observed or expected given isolated fixture-based execution.

materialClaimSpecificSafeFailureRecallMi.note: Computed on the 7 IN_SAMPLE material NO_CREDIT claims - the only claims for which this recall is measurable this run.

materialClaimCreditOrSafeFailureMin.note: Measured 100% on the 13 IN_SAMPLE material claims (7 credited + 6 safely-routed). This gate is only measurable on the compiled sample; it cannot be extrapolated to the 97 DISCOVERED_NOT_SAMPLED claims that were never compiled due to the cost ceiling.

materialSubstantiveCreditRateMin.note: Measured on the 13 IN_SAMPLE material claims, an unbiased deterministic-stratified sample. Falls materially short of the frozen 85% bar.

quantitativeComponentCorrectnessAmongCre.note: 5/7 credited claims carry a real quantitative component (all correct); 2/7 have none to check.

operativeStateCorrectnessOnMateriallyRel.note: This package poses exactly one operative-state question (which of doc-a/doc-b/doc-c currently governs). Headroom produced neither the correct answer nor an incorrect one - an empty, unresolved result. Measured against the single materially-relevant operative-state determination this package requires, correctness = 0/1.

note: No threshold was weakened, added, or reinterpreted after seeing results. All values above are taken verbatim from 00-validation-contract.json, frozen before package selection in the original Phase 3F.2 phase.
